notes.title: Ports, Soundtracks, Modding, and Demos!
notes.content:
[h1]What have I and the contributers been doing?[/h1]

As of now, we're in alpha testing, I'm hoping i can get a demo out by the end of the month. But that's not all, look at this!

[h3]Mac Shit, Linux Shit[/h3]

As it's going right now, the game is very well into being ported to OSX (11.00 and above do not support this type of game). But for a linux port, i'm currently looking into SteamOS, but no promises.

[h3]Modding[/h3]

This is where it gets interesting, the entire game will be released along with a modders kit, what is in this modders kit you ask? Every file and asset in the game. Meaning anybody with RPG Maker MV can edit and mod the game to their desires. This is exciting because anybody can translate it, or make their own fangame using this game's mechanics!

[h3]Soundtrack?[/h3]

As of now, the soundtrack will be distributed via steam, with a release in October, along with the game.

Want more info as it comes out? Want to know about the android port? Want to help out with the game? Join the discord!

https://discord.gg/qKKt3uqmP5
